situation: Hand is full and Gold will be wasted
action: Play cards from hand before buying more
rationale: Gold over the hand cap is lost value

situation: Early turn with no Gold left
action: End the turn immediately
rationale: No value in refreshing with zero Gold

situation: Healthy and stuck on tier 3 mid-game
action: Upgrade to tier 4
rationale: Tier 4 minions scale into the mid game when health buffers the tempo loss

situation: Low health and behind on tiers
action: Buy the strongest tempo minions, stay on tier
rationale: Upgrading sacrifices tempo; dying to tempo loss loses the game

situation: Exactly one Taunt shields the biggest attacker
action: Place the Taunt left of the carry
rationale: The Taunt absorbs the first attack aimed at the carry

situation: The next opponent showed Cleave last combat
action: Spread high-value minions apart
rationale: Cleave hits the neighbours of its target

situation: A deathrattle summons minions on death
action: Place summoning deathrattles on the right
rationale: Summons appear at the death position; right side keeps them out of early attacks

situation: Board commits to Beasts and the shop offers one
action: Buy the Beast over a higher-stat off-tribe minion
rationale: Tribe commitment compounds

situation: Late Dragons with battlecry-heavy hand
action: Prioritize battlecry triggers
rationale: Battlecry synergy multiplies each play

situation: A buff spell and a Divine Shield minion on board
action: Cast the buff on the Divine Shield minion
rationale: The shield protects the buff investment through the first hit

situation: Two copies in hand and the third is in the shop
action: Buy the third copy even at tempo cost
rationale: The triple reward discovers a tier higher and snowballs

situation: The next opponent fields more minions
action: Position defensively and value taunts
rationale: The side with fewer minions attacks second

situation: Gold sits at the cap late game
action: Spend down before ending the turn
rationale: Capped gold is lost income

situation: Murloc board with a poisonous craft available
action: Take poisonous over raw stats
rationale: Poisonous trades up into big minions

situation: A Windfury minion on board
action: Place it leftmost among attackers
rationale: Two early attacks break a taunt or shield fast

situation: Critical health late game
action: All-in on tempo buys, ignore upgrades
rationale: Survival now outweighs scaling

situation: Hero power targets a friendly minion
action: Target the highest-Attack minion
rationale: Damage and buff effects scale with the target's Attack

situation: Mech board with Magnetic cards in hand
action: Magnetize onto the biggest Mech body
rationale: Magnetic buffs ride a body that already survives

situation: Won the last two combats with a small board
action: Keep the comp compact, buy quality over quantity
rationale: Small strong boards dodge the damage cap better

situation: The shop shows a tier-5 minion worth keeping
action: Freeze the shop
rationale: Guaranteed access next turn beats a reroll gamble

situation: Both a Reborn and a Divine Shield minion with one buff
action: Shield the non-Reborn minion
rationale: Reborn already survives death; shielding it wastes overlap

situation: Undead board with Avenge triggers
action: Keep minion count high, avoid selling Avenge minions
rationale: Avenge counts friendly deaths; density matters

situation: An Avenge(2) minion and a cheap sellable body
action: Sell the weakest to trigger Avenge when safe
rationale: Avenge triggers on friendly deaths; timing trades a body for value

situation: The next opponent is a ghost
action: Expect their frozen final warband
rationale: Ghost boards do not change; position against what you saw
